Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh says "America will be richer," and more productive from this AI cycle if it repeats prior positive technology trends.

Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh said AI "is the most significant change in our economy in my adult lifetime," in a testimony before Congress on Tuesday.

"It's a huge opportunity, but it also comes with risks and challenges," Warsh added.

Video

Buybacks aren't just "returning capital" — they are an active investment decision, Jamie Dimon said on JPMorgan's Q2 earnings call Tuesday.

Dimon also added that companies need to stop hiding behind M&A and, instead, focus on organic growth. yhoo.it/44ZVgBl

I asked JP Morgan CEO Jamie Dimon if an interest rate hike from the Fed would cause some of the risks he laid out in the earnings release today to collide. He laughed briefly and said:

“I wish I knew the answer to that question. We don't know. We're just isolating that there are issues out there. They're pretty important and substantial. You know, they can easily go away. They can easily collide in a way that will surprise you. And it won't just be the Fed and inflation. It might be a whole bunch of the geopolitical stuff, so just something to keep an eye on. Of course, we're always preparing for various types of risks.”
